purpose: Machine-readable Current runtime capability governance. This registry governs implementation rights only; it is not a corpus, route, Scope mapping, permission or Canon data authority.

flexsearch_uid_cache_table.right: FlexSearch may use a Neon cache table for transient UID working sets used by keyword, keyword-ratio, autocomplete, repeated local lexical matching and related statistics workflows.
flexsearch_uid_cache_table.notes: A UID working-set cache is an execution aid, not a second corpus authority. Refactors, cleanup passes, Neon-first rules and anti-duplication rules must preserve this capability.
